oldBody.en: According to the Biographical Dictionary of Republican China, Wu T'ing-fang was born on 9 July 1842 at Singapore. He was called to the English bar in 1876, becoming the first Chinese barrister, and in 1897 he was appointed minister to the United States, Spain and Peru.
oldBody.zh-Hant: 據《民國人物傳記辭典》條目，伍廷芳生於1842年7月9日，出生於新加坡；1876年取得英國律師資格，成為首位華人大律師，1897年被任命為駐美國、西班牙與秘魯公使。

newBody.en: According to the BnF authority record, Wu Tingfang was born on 30 July 1842 in Malacca. He was called to the English bar in 1876, becoming the first Chinese barrister, and in 1897 he was appointed minister to the United States, Spain and Peru.
newBody.zh-Hant: 據法國國家圖書館（BnF）權威記錄，伍廷芳於1842年7月30日生於馬六甲；1876年取得英國律師資格，成為首位華人大律師，1897年被任命為駐美國、西班牙與秘魯公使。

oldBody.en: In 1932, in the midst of the economic crisis, Hansson became leader of a Social Democratic minority government, and in 1933 reached the so-called crisis settlement with the Agrarian League. His government was replaced by an Agrarian League government in summer 1936, but in September that year he formed a government again. After the outbreak of the Winter War in December 1939 he formed a national coalition government, and externally Sweden’s formal, later somewhat contested neutrality was secured. He died in Stockholm on 5 October 1946.
oldBody.zh-Hant: 1932年經濟危機中，漢森出任社會民主黨少數政府的領導人，1933年與農民聯盟達成「危機協議」。1936年夏天其政府被農民聯盟政府取代，同年9月他再度組閣。1939年12月冬季戰爭爆發後他組成國家聯合政府，對外確保瑞典形式上、後來頗受爭議的中立。他於1946年10月5日在斯德哥爾摩逝世。

newBody.en: In 1932, in the midst of the economic crisis, Hansson became leader of a Social Democratic minority government, and in 1933 reached the so-called crisis settlement with the Agrarian League. His government was replaced by an Agrarian League government in summer 1936, but in September that year he formed a government again. After the outbreak of the Winter War in December 1939 he formed a national coalition government, and externally Sweden’s formal, later somewhat contested neutrality was secured. He died on 6 October 1946.
newBody.zh-Hant: 1932年經濟危機中，漢森出任社會民主黨少數政府的領導人，1933年與農民聯盟達成「危機協議」。1936年夏天其政府被農民聯盟政府取代，同年9月他再度組閣。1939年12月冬季戰爭爆發後他組成國家聯合政府，對外確保瑞典形式上、後來頗受爭議的中立。他於1946年10月6日逝世。
